role: The small tree generators of population and sapling growth: WorldGenTrees (oak, and the jungle variant with vines and cocoa pods), WorldGenForest (birch and tall birch), WorldGenSwamp (swamp oak with vines), WorldGenShrub (jungle bush), the lone-jungle-sapling fallback, and their FeatureProbe rows.

structs.name: TREES, JUNGLE, FOREST, SWAMP, SHRUB
structs.java: the tree rows appended to oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/FeatureProbe.java's FEATURES table (jungle has one row per minTreeHeight 4..10)

structs.name: COCOA_DX, COCOA_DZ
structs.java: Direction.offsetX/offsetZ through Direction.rotateOpposite for the cocoa pod placement

gpu: line 89, function grow_vines: for(;;) bounded by the 4-vine counter
line 343, function feature_swamp: while loop down through water, bounded only by terrain
line 454, function feature_shrub: while loop down through air and leaves, bounded by y > 0
lines 57-60, function mat_is: material identity by strcmp on names on every check
notes: Writes go through features_tree_write, so sapling growth (randomtick.c, features_sapling_jungle) gets flag 3. The leaves' breakBlock persistence callback is in world.c, not here. Java field names minTreeHeight/vinesGrow/metaWood/metaLeaves are MCP names from memory, not verified against oracle/src.
